Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the target individual, switching from "Frederick of Luxembourg" (965–1019), whose Wikipedia page was open, to his son "Frederick, Duke of Lower Lorraine" (c. 1003–1065). This led to concluding the paternal grandfather as Siegfried of Luxembourg (father of the duke’s father) instead of tracing the correct lineage for the elder Frederick. For Frederick of Luxembourg (965–1019), the paternal grandfather is Siegfried’s father, Wigeric of Lotharingia. The misidentification of the subject caused the final answer to be off by one generation.
